package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// GetLearningWorkspace reads the bounded S10 Teacher projection. It has no
// command, receipt, outbox, or lifecycle side effect.
type GetLearningWorkspace struct {
	Reader  repository.LearningWorkspaceSnapshotReader
	Enabled bool
}

func (useCase GetLearningWorkspace) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearningWorkspace, error) {
	// Keep this check before validation and repository access. A default-off
	// deployment must not reveal or read new workspace state.
	if !useCase.Enabled {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled
	}
	if useCase.Reader == nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, errors.New("learning workspace reader is required")
	}
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if !validStudentUUID(studentID) {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	source, err := useCase.Reader.ReadLearningWorkspace(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, err
	}
	source.StudentID = studentID
	result, err := domain.BuildStudentLearningWorkspace(source)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return result, nil
}
